Head_and_Face: Bill is short, straight, and dark.
Eyes are dark and round with a prominent white eye-ring in some subspecies.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is compact, rounded with short tail.
Plumage is uniformly dark brown to slate-grey with a glossy, water-resistant texture.
Some subspecies exhibit a white or rufous breast band.
Plumage is dense and oily, providing waterproofing during diving.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Wings are short and rounded, adapted for rapid, direct flight close to water surfaces.
Feet are anisodactyl with long, slender toes and sharp claws adapted for gripping submerged rocks.
Tail is short and often held cocked upward.

Head_and_Face: Head is small relative to body with a sharp, hooked beak.
Eyes are keen and forward-facing with yellow or orange irises.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is slender.
Plumage varies: common patterns include dark brown upperparts with lighter underparts, rufous or white patches on wings, and barred tail feathers.
Plumage texture is smooth and tightly appressed.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Wings are long, pointed, and narrow with deeply notched or forked primary tips.
Tail is long and deeply forked in many species.
Legs are relatively short with sharp, curved talons.

Head_and_Face: Adult has a pure white head sharply contrasting with dark body.
Bill is massive, hooked, and bright yellow with a sharp, curved tip.
Eyes are pale yellow with a fierce, forward-facing gaze.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is large with dark brown to blackish plumage.
Adult tail is pure white, sharply contrasting with body and wings.
Juveniles are entirely dark brown with mottled white patches.
Plumage texture is smooth and glossy with a dense undercoat.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Wings are broad and flat with finger-like primary tips.
Tail is wedge-shaped (cuneate) and relatively short.
Legs are yellow with thick, scaled skin and powerful talons with long, curved black claws.

Head_and_Face: Head and neck are naked (featherless) with skin coloration ranging from pale grey to bright red, orange, or yellow.
Bill is strong and hooked but relatively weak compared to active predators.
Eyes are dark and positioned laterally.
Body_and_Plumage: Body plumage is predominantly dark brown to black with some species exhibiting white neck ruffs or wing patches.
Plumage texture is smooth and tightly appressed.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Wings are extremely broad with finger-like primary tips.
Tail is short and wedge-shaped.
Legs are short with weak talons; feet are adapted for walking on the ground.

Head_and_Face: Facial disc is a prominent, concentric-ringed structure of stiff, radiating feathers forming a grey, dish-shaped frame around the face.
Eyes are small and yellow, positioned within the facial disc.
Bill is short, hooked, and yellow, concealed by facial feathers.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage is predominantly grey with fine, concentric barring patterns creating a cryptic, bark-like appearance.
Underparts are pale grey with dark streaks.
Plumage texture is exceptionally soft and fluffy.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Wings are extremely broad and rounded with soft, fringed flight feathers enabling silent flight.
Tail is long and barred.
Legs are feathered to the toes with grey plumage.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and flattened with prominent parotoid glands (poison glands) behind the eyes.
Eyes are small, dark, and protruding with gold-flecked irises.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is robust and cylindrical.
Vivid black and yellow (or orange) warning coloration: glossy black dorsal surface with irregular yellow spots, stripes, or bands.
Skin is smooth, moist, and glandular with a glossy, wet-looking appearance.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Limbs are short and stout with four digits on forelimbs and five on hindlimbs; digits are blunt and unwebbed.
Tail is laterally compressed and shorter than body length, with a rounded tip.

Head_and_Face: Eyes are small and dark.
Breeding male exhibits a dorsal crest (serrated ridge) running from head to tail tip.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is small and semiaquatic.
Breeding male has dark brown to olive body with small dark spots and bright orange to yellow underside with dark spots.
Female and non-breeding male lack the dorsal crest and exhibit duller brown coloration with a yellow-orange belly.
Skin is smooth and granular with a slightly rough texture.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Limbs are short with four digits on forelimbs and five on hindlimbs.
Hind feet are partially webbed during breeding season.
Tail is laterally compressed and keeled (ridged) for swimming efficiency in breeding males.

Head_and_Face: Head is small and pointed with prominent, dark eyes.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is slender and elongated.
Vivid orange-red dorsal surface with small red spots outlined in black.
Ventral surface is bright orange with small black spots.
Skin is rough and granular (not smooth like aquatic stage), providing a textured, bumpy appearance.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Limbs are short with four digits on forelimbs and five on hindlimbs; digits are blunt and unwebbed.
Tail is laterally compressed and shorter than body length.

Head_and_Face: Head is broad and rounded with small, dark eyes and inconspicuous parotoid glands.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is robust and cylindrical with glossy black dorsal surface.
Pattern of two rows of large, bright yellow (or occasionally orange) spots running longitudinally along the back from head to tail.
Ventral surface is uniformly dark grey to black.
Skin is smooth, moist, and glandular with a glossy, wet appearance.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Limbs are short and stout with four digits on forelimbs and five on hindlimbs; digits are blunt and unwebbed.
Tail is laterally compressed and shorter than body length, with a rounded tip and continuation of the spotted pattern.

Head_and_Face: Pair of feathery, branched external gills (three on each side of the head) projecting laterally from behind the head; gills are typically red or pink.
Head is broad and flattened with a wide, upturned mouth giving a permanent 'smiling' expression.
Eyes are small, dark, and lidless.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is elongated and slender.
Wild type coloration is dark brown to black with mottled patterning; albino and leucistic (pink/white) varieties are common.
Skin is smooth, moist, and translucent in light-colored varieties, revealing internal organs.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Limbs are short and slender with four digits on forelimbs and five on hindlimbs; digits are thin and delicate.
Tail is long, laterally compressed, and finned (dorsal and ventral fin membranes) for aquatic propulsion.
